rationale: Rename the existing canonical record to Skyline Renewables. Ardian's current infrastructure portfolio and 2025 integrated report identify Skyline—not Dauntless—as the manager-level investment. Dauntless was formed separately in 2024 to manage Skyline and 1370, so it is not Skyline's legal successor or rebrand. Preserve the existing Ardian/AAIF IV ownership period and 2018 entry, correct the company boundary and sourced milestones, and do not add projects or the separate 1370 portfolio.
